newsitem.title: FINLAND: NEW FINNISH COOP BANK GROUP H1 PROFIT FIM 75.5 MLN.
newsitem.headline: NEW FINNISH COOP BANK GROUP H1 PROFIT FIM 75.5 MLN.

text.p: The combined operating profit before tax of the 45 independent local cooperative banks which this year formed a group of their own was 75.5 million markka in the first half of 1997, the group said in a statement on Tuesday.
The statement did not give any comparison and nobody was immediately available for comment.
The group said the six-month result was "good" and would raise the group's capital adequacy ratio from an end-1996 level of 20.5 percent. But it did not say by how much the ratio would rise.
The group said there was reason to expect the earnings trend to remain stable in the second half of 1997.
